s.d: ζεστός, -ή, -όν (ζέω) [in Aq.: [[leviticus 6 21|Lev.6:21;]] in Al.: [[leviticus 7 12|Lev.7:12]] * ;] boiling hot (Strab., al.): metaphorically, [[revelation 3 15|Rev.3:15-16.]]† (AS)

ζεῦγος, -εος (-ους), τό (ζεύγνυμι, to yoke), [in LXX chiefly for צֶמֶד, [[judges 19 3|Jdg.19:3]], al. ;] 1. a yoke of beasts: [[luke 14 19|Luk.14:19.]] 2. a pair of any­thing, [[luke 2 24|Luk.2:24]] (LXX).† (AS)

ζευκτήριος, -α -ον (ζεύγνυμι), fit for joining. As subst., (a) ζευκτήριον, τό = ζυγόν, a yoke; (b) ζευκτηρία, -ας, ἡ = ζεύγλη, the crossbar of a double rudder: [[acts 27 40|Act.27:40]] (found nowhere else).† (AS)
Ζεύς genitive, Διός, dative, Διΐ, accusative, Δία (Δίαν, D, al.), Zeus (Lat. Jupiter): [[acts 14 12|Act.14:12-13.]]† (AS)

ζέω [in LXX for רוּם, רָתַח, metaphorically, 4Ma.18:20 ;] to boil, be hot; metaphorically, of anger, love, zeal: ptcp., fervent: τ. πνεύματι, [[acts 18 25|Act.18:25]], [[romans 12 11|Rom.12:11]].† (AS)

ζῆλος, -ου, ὁ and in late Gk., also -εος, τό ([[2-corinthians 9 2|2Co.9:2]], [[philippians 3 6|Php.3:6]]), [in LXX for קִנְאָה, [[numbers 25 11|Num.25:11]], al. ;] 1. zeal: [[2-corinthians 7 11|2Co.7:11 9:2]]; κατά ζῆλος, [[philippians 3 6|Php.3:6;]] with genitive obj., [[john 2 17|Jhn.2:17]] (LXX), [[romans 10 2|Rom.10:2;]] before ὑπέρ, [[2-corinthians 7 7|2Co.7:7;]] with genitive subj., θεοῦ, [[2-corinthians 11 2|2Co.11:2;]] πυρός, [[hebrews 10 27|Heb.10:27]] (cf. [[isaiah 26 11|Isa.26:11]], Wis.5:18, and cf. Westc., in l). 2. jealousy: [[romans 13 13|Rom.13:13]], [[1-corinthians 3 3|1Co.3:3 3:2]] [[2-corinthians 12 20|2Co.12:20]], [[galatians 5 20|Gal.5:20]] (WH, txt, RV), [[james 3 14|Jas.3:14, 16]]; πλησθῆναι ζήλου [[acts 5 17|Act.5:17 13:45]]; pl., ζῆλοι (see B1., § 32, 6), [[galatians 5 20|Gal.5:20]], WH, mg.† (AS)

ζηλόω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for קָנָא pi. ;] 1. to burn with envy or jealousy, to be jealousy: absol., [[acts 7 9|Act.7:9 17:5]], [[1-corinthians 13 4|1Co.13:4]], [[james 4 2|Jas.4:2]] (R, mg., cf. Mayor, in l). 2. to seek or desire eagerly: with accusative of thing(s), [[1-corinthians 12 31|1Co.12:31 14:1 14:39]] (cf. Sir.50:18, Wis.1:12); with accusative of person(s), [[2-corinthians 11 2|2Co.11:2]], [[galatians 4 17|Gal.4:17]]; pass., [[galatians 4 18|Gal.4:18.]]† (AS)

ζηλωτής, -οῦ, ὁ (ζηλόω), [in LXX for קַנָּא (θεὸς ζ.), [[exodus 20 5|Exo.20:5 34:14]], [[deuteronomy 4 24|Deu.4:24 5:9 6:15]]; קַנּוֹא, [[nahum 1 2|Nam.1:2]] (θεός); pl., I [[esther 8 72|Est.8:72;]] ζ. τῶν νόμων, 2Ma.4:2;τὸν ζ. Φινεές, 4Ma.18:12 (cf. [[numbers 25 11|Num.25:11]])* ;] 1. in cl. an emulator, zealous admirer (Plat., al.). 2. eagerly desirous, zealous; (a) absol., as in OT, ll. with; (b) with genitive obj.: (zealous to acquire or to defend), [[1-corinthians 14 12|1Co.14:12]], [[titus 2 14|Tit.2:14]], [[1-peter 3 13|1Pe.3:13]]; τ. νόμου (2Mac, l.with), [[acts 21 20|Act.21:20;]] παραδόσεων, [[galatians 1 14|Gal.1:14;]] with genitive of person(s), θεοῦ, [[acts 22 3|Act.22:3.]] 3. In FlJ, NT, a Zealot, member of the Jewish party so called: as surname of the Apostle Simon, [[luke 6 15|Luk.6:15]], [[acts 1 13|Act.1:13]].† (AS)
Ζηλωτής In FlJ, NT, a Zealot, member of the Jewish party so called: as surname of the Apostle Simon, [[luke 6 15|Luk.6:15]], [[acts 1 13|Act.1:13]].† (AS)
ζημία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX for עָנַשׁ; עֹנֶשׁ ni. and cognate forms ;] damage, loss: [[acts 27 10|Act.27:10, 21]] [[philippians 3 8|Php.3:8]]; opposite to κέρδος, [[philippians 3 7|Php.3:7.]]† (AS)

ζημόω, -ῶ (ζημία), [in LXX chiefly for עָנַשׁ ;] to damage. Pass., to suffer loss, forfeit, lose: absol., [[1-corinthians 3 15|1Co.3:15;]] before ἐν, [[2-corinthians 7 9|2Co.7:9;]] with accusative of thing(s) (see B1., § 34, 6), τ. ψυχήν, [[matthew 16 26|Mat.16:26]], [[mark 8 36|Mrk.8:36]]; ἑαυτόν, [[luke 9 25|Luk.9:25;]] τ. πάντα, [[philippians 3 8|Php.3:8.]]† (AS)
Ζηνᾶς, -ᾶ, accusative -ᾶν (contr. from Ζηνόδωρος), Zenas: [[titus 3 13|Tit.3:13.]]† (AS)

ζητέω, -ῶ, [in LXX chiefly for בּקשׁ pi., also for דּרשׁ, etc. ;] 1. to seek, seek for: [[matthew 7 7|Mat.7:7]], 8 [[luke 11 9|Luk.11:9]], 10; with accusative of person(s), [[mark 1 37|Mrk.1:37]], [[luke 2 48|Luk.2:48]], [[john 6 24|Jhn.6:24]], al.; id. before ἐν, [[acts 9 11|Act.9:11;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 13 45|Mat.13:45]], [[luke 19 10|Luk.19:10]]; before ἐν, [[luke 13 6|Luk.13:6]], 7; ψυχήν, of plotting against one's life ( [[exodus 4 19|Exo.4:19]], al.), [[matthew 2 20|Mat.2:20]], [[romans 11 3|Rom.11:3]]" (LXX) . Metaphorical, to seek by thinking, search after, inquire into: [[mark 11 18|Mrk.11:18]], [[luke 12 28|Luk.12:28]], Jhn.16:19; τ. θεόν, [[acts 17 27|Act.17:27.]] 2. to seek or strive after, desire: [[matthew 12 46|Mat.12:46]], [[mark 12 12|Mrk.12:12]], [[luke 9 9|Luk.9:9]], [[john 5 18|Jhn.5:18]], [[romans 10 3|Rom.10:3]], al.; τ. θάνατον, [[revelation 9 6|Rev.9:6;]] τ. βασιλείαν τ. θεοῦ, [[matthew 6 33|Mat.6:33]] (Dalman, Words, 121f.); τὰ ἄνω, [[colossians 3 1|Col.3:1;]] εἰρήνην, [[1-peter 3 11|1Pe.3:11]] (LXX). 3. to require, demand: with accusative of thing(s), [[mark 8 12|Mrk.8:12]], [[luke 11 29|Luk.11:29]], [[1-corinthians 1 22|1Co.1:22]], [[2-corinthians 13 3|2Co.13:3]]; before παρά, [[mark 8 11|Mrk.8:11]], al.; ἵνα, [[1-corinthians 4 2|1Co.4:2]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-ζητέω). (AS)
ζήτημα, -τος, τό (ζητέω), [in LXX: ζ. τίθεσθαι (דָּרַשׁ ni.), [[ezekiel 36 37|Eze.36:37]] A * ;] an inquiry, question: [[acts 15 2|Act.15:2 18:15 23:29 25:19 26:3]].† (AS)

ζήτησις, -εως, ἡ (ζητέω). 1. a seeking, search. 2. a questioning, inquiry, debate: [[acts 15 2|Act.15:2]], 7, [[2-timothy 2 23|2Ti.2:23]], [[titus 3 9|Tit.3:9]]; before περί, [[john 3 26|Jhn.3:26]], [[acts 25 20|Act.25:20]], [[1-timothy 6 4|1Ti.6:4]].† (AS)
ζιζάνιον, -ου, τό (in Talmud זוּנִין), zizanium (EV, tares), a kind of darnel, resembling wheat: [[matthew 13 25|Mat.13:25-40]] (cf. DB, see word "Tares").† (AS)
Ζοροβάβελ (FlJ, Ζοροβάβηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְרֻבָּבֶל), Zerubbabel ([[1-chronicles 3 19|1Ch.3:19]], al.): [[matthew 1 12|Mat.1:12-13]] [[luke 3 27|Luk.3:27]].† (AS)
Ζοροβάβελ (FlJ, Ζοροβάβηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְרֻבָּבֶל), Zerubbabel ([[1-chronicles 3 19|1Ch.3:19]], al.): [[matthew 1 12|Mat.1:12-13]] [[luke 3 27|Luk.3:27]].† (AS)

ζόφος, -ου, ὁ (akin to γνόφος, which see), [in Sm.: [[exodus 10 22|Exo.10:22]], [[job 28 3|Job.28:3]], [[psalms 11 2|Psa.11:2 91:6]], [[isaiah 59 9|Isa.59:9]] * ;] in Hom, the gloom of the under-world; hence, darkness, deep gloom (poët. and late prose writers): [[hebrews 12 18|Heb.12:18]], [[2-peter 2 4|2Pe.2:4 2:17]], Ju 6 13.† ὁμίχλη, -ης, ἡ, [in LXX for עֲרָפֶל, etc. ;] a mist: [[2-peter 2 17|2Pe.2:17]] SYN.: νέφος, νεφέλη, both thicker than ὁ (AS)

ζυγός (in cl. more frequently τὸ ζυγόν), -οῦ, ὁ (ζεύγνυμι), [in LXX for עֹל, מֹאזֵן, etc. ;] 1. a yoke; metaphorically, of bondage or submission to authority: [[matthew 11 29|Mat.11:29-30]], [[acts 15 10|Act.15:10]], [[galatians 5 1|Gal.5:1]], [[1-timothy 6 1|1Ti.6:1]]. 2. a balance: [[revelation 6 5|Rev.6:5]] (of. [[isaiah 40 12|Isa.40:12]], al.).† (AS)

ζύμη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX for חָמֵץ, [[exodus 12 16|Exo.12:16 13:3 23:18 34:25]], [[deuteronomy 16 3|Deu.16:3]]; שְׂאֹר, [[exodus 12 16|Exo.12:16, 19 13:7]], [[leviticus 2 11|Lev.2:11]], [[deuteronomy 16 4|Deu.16:4]] * ;] leaven: [[matthew 13 33|Mat.13:33]], [[luke 13 21|Luk.13:21]]; τ. ἄρτου, [[matthew 16 12|Mat.16:12.]] Metaphorical, of a moral influence or tendency, always, exc. in the Parable of the Leaven ([[matthew 13 33|Mat.13:33]], [[luke 13 21|Luk.13:21]]), for evil: [[1-corinthians 5 6|1Co.5:6-8]], [[galatians 5 9|Gal.5:9]]; ζ. τ. Φαρισαίων, [[matthew 16 6|Mat.16:6, 11]], [[mark 8 16|Mrk.8:16]], [[luke 12 1|Luk.12:1]] (Cremer, 723).† (AS)

ζυμόω, -ῶ (ζύμη), [in LXX for חָמֵץ, [[exodus 12 34|Exo.12:34, 39]] [[leviticus 6 17|Lev.6:17 23:17]], [[hosea 7 4|Hos.7:4]] * ;] to leaven: [[matthew 13 33|Mat.13:33]], [[luke 13 21|Luk.13:21]], [[1-corinthians 5 6|1Co.5:6]], [[galatians 5 9|Gal.5:9]].† (AS)

ζωγρέω, -ῶ (ζωός, alive, + ἀγρεύω) [in LXX chiefly for חָיָה hi. ;] to catch alive, take captive: metaphorically, [[luke 5 10|Luk.5:10;]] pass., [[2-timothy 2 26|2Ti.2:26]] (on the meaning and construction, see Ellic., CGT, in l).† (AS)

ζωή, -ῆς, ἡ (ζάω), [in LXX chiefly for חַיִּים ;] life (in Hom., Hdt., = βίος, which see; later, existence, vita quâ vivimus, as distinct from βίος, vita quam vivimus; opposite to θάνατος); 1. of natural life: [[luke 16 25|Luk.16:25]], [[acts 8 33|Act.8:33]], [[1-corinthians 15 19|1Co.15:19]], [[1-timothy 4 8|1Ti.4:8]], [[hebrews 7 3|Heb.7:3]], [[james 4 14|Jas.4:14]]; πνεῦμα ζωῆς, [[revelation 11 11|Rev.11:11;]] ψυχὴ ζωῆς ( [[genesis 1 30|Gen.1:30]]), [[revelation 16 3|Rev.16:3]]; of the life of one risen from the dead, [[romans 5 10|Rom.5:10]], [[hebrews 7 16|Heb.7:16]]. 2. Of the life of the kingdom of God, the present life of grace and the life of glory which is to follow (Dalman, Words, 156ff.; Westc, Epp. Jo., 214ff.; Cremer, 272ff.): [[john 6 51|Jhn.6:51, 53]] [[romans 7 10|Rom.7:10 8:6, 10]] [[philippians 2 16|Php.2:16]], [[colossians 3 4|Col.3:4]], [[2-peter 1 3|2Pe.1:3]]; αἰώνος (reff. supr.; DCG, i, 538a, ii, 30f.), [[john 4 36|Jhn.4:36 12:50 17:3]], [[1-john 1 2|1Jn.1:2]], al.; τ. φῶς τῆς ζ., [[john 8 12|Jhn.8:12;]] ὁ Λόγος τ. ζ., [[1-john 1 1|1Jn.1:1;]] ὁ ἄρτος τ. ζ., [[john 6 35|Jo 6:35, 48]]; δικαίωσις ζωῆς, [[romans 5 18|Rom.5:18;]] μετάνοια εἰς ζ., [[acts 11 18|Act.11:18;]] ἐν αὐτῷ ζ. ἦν, [[john 1 4|Jhn.1:4;]] ζ. ἡ ἐν. Χ. Ἰ., [[2-timothy 1 1|2Ti.1:1;]] τὰ πρὸς ζωήν, [[2-peter 1 3|2Pe.1:3]], al.; στέφανος τῆς ζ., [[james 1 12|Jas.1:12]], [[revelation 2 10|Rev.2:10]]; χάρις ζωῆς (genitive expl.), [[1-peter 3 7|1Pe.3:7;]] ζ. καὶ εἰρήνη, [[romans 8 6|Rom.8:6;]] ζ. καὶ ἀφθαρσία, [[2-timothy 1 10|2Ti.1:10;]] ἀνάστασις ζωῆς, [[john 5 29|Jhn.5:29;]] βίβλος ζωῆς, [[philippians 4 3|Php.4:3]], [[revelation 3 5|Rev.3:5]]; ξύλον ζωῆς, [[revelation 2 7|Rev.2:7;]] ὕδωρ ζωῆς, [[revelation 22 17|Rev.22:17;]] meton., of that which has life: τ. πνεῦμα, [[romans 8 10|Rom.8:10;]] ῥήματα, [[john 6 63|Jhn.6:63;]] of one who gives life, [[john 11 25|Jhn.11:25 14:6]], [[1-john 1 2|1Jn.1:2]]; ἡ ἐντολή, [[john 12 50|Jhn.12:50.]] SYN.: see: βίος. (AS)

ζώνη, -ης, ἡ (ζώννυμι) [in LXX for אַבְנֵט, חֲגוֹר, etc. ;] a belt, girdle: [[matthew 3 4|Mat.3:4]], [[mark 1 6|Mrk.1:6]], [[acts 21 11|Act.21:11]], [[revelation 1 13|Rev.1:13 15:6]]; as a receptacle for money, [[matthew 10 9|Mat.10:9]], [[mark 6 8|Mrk.6:8]].† (AS)

ζώννυμι and ζωννύω [in LXX chiefly for חָגַר ;] to gird: with accusative of person(s), [[john 21 18|Jhn.21:18.]] Mid., to gird oneself: [[acts 12 8|Act.12:8]] (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, περι-, ὑπο-ζώννυμι).† (AS)

ζωογονέω, -ῶ (ζωός, alive, γένεσθαι), [in LXX [[exodus 1 17|Exo.1:17-18, 22]], [[judges 8 19|Jdg.8:19]], [[1-samuel 2 6|1Ki.2:6 27:9 27:11]], [[1-kings 20 31|3Ki.20:31]], [[2-kings 7 4|4Ki.7:4]] (חָיָה pi., hi.), [[leviticus 11 47|Lev.11:47]] (חַי)* ;] 1. in cl., to engender, produce alive, endue with life. 2. In LXX. and NT, to preserve alive (DCG, ii, 606; Cremer, 274): [[luke 17 33|Luk.17:33]], [[acts 7 19|Act.7:19]], [[1-timothy 6 13|1Ti.6:13]] (EV, quickeneth; R, mg., preserveth).† (AS)

ζῷον (Rec. ζῶον, see LS, see word), -ου, τό (ζωός, alive), [in LXX for חַי (chiefly) and cognate forms; frequently in Wis ;] a living creature, an animal: [[revelation 4 6|Rev.4:6-9 5:6]] ff. [[revelation 6 1|Rev.6:1]] ff. [[revelation 7 11|Rev.7:11 14:3 15:7 19:4]]; ζῴων τ. αἷμα, [[hebrews 13 11|Heb.13:11;]] ἄλογα ζ., [[2-peter 2 12|2Pe.2:12]], Ju 10.† SYN.: θηρίον, in which the brutal, bestial element is emphasized, and which is never used of sacrificial animals. On the other hand, ζ. is the more comprehensive, as expressing the vital element common to the whole anima] creation (see Tr., Syn., LXXxi; Cremer, 274). (AS)

ζωο-ποιέω, ῶ [in LXX for חָיָה pi., hi., [[judges 21 14|Jdg.21:14]], [[2-kings 5 7|4Ki.5:7]], [[nehemiah 9 6|Neh.9:6]], [[job 36 6|Job.36:6]], [[psalms 70 20|Psa.70:20]], [[ecclesiastes 7 12|Ecc.7:12]] * ;] 1. in cl. (= ζωογονέω), to produce alive. 2. In LXX and NT, to make alive, cause to live, quicken (DCG, ii, 606a; Cremer, 275): [[john 5 21|Jhn.5:21 6:53]], [[romans 4 17|Rom.4:17 8:11]], [[1-corinthians 15 45|1Co.15:45]], [[2-corinthians 3 6|2Co.3:6]], [[galatians 3 21|Gal.3:21]]. Pass., [[1-corinthians 15 22|1Co.15:22 15:36]], [[1-peter 3 18|1Pe.3:18]].† (AS)

ἤ, disjunctive and comparative particle (Bl., §36, 12; 77, 11); 1. disjunctive, or; (a) between single words: [[matthew 5 17|Mat.5:17]] [[mark 6 56|Mrk.6:56]], [[luke 2 24|Luk.2:24]], [[john 6 19|Jhn.6:19]], [[romans 1 21|Rom.1:21]], al.; (b) before a sentence expressing a variation, denial or refutation of a previous statement, frequently in interrog. form: [[matthew 7 4|Mat.7:4]], 9 [[mark 12 14|Mrk.12:14]], [[luke 13 4|Luk.13:4]], [[romans 3 29|Rom.3:29 6:3 9:21]], [[1-corinthians 6 9|1Co.6:9]], 16 9:6, [[2-corinthians 11 7|2Co.11:7;]] ἤ . . . ἤ, either . . . or, [[matthew 6 24|Mat.6:24]], [[luke 16 13|Luk.16:13]], [[1-corinthians 14 6|1Co.14:6]]; (with) in a disjunctive question (as Lat. an after utrum): [[matthew 9 5|Mat.9:5]], [[mark 2 9|Mrk.2:9]], [[luke 7 19|Luk.7:19]], al.; after πότερον, [[john 7 17|Jhn.7:17;]] μή, [[1-corinthians 9 8|1Co.9:8;]] μήτι, [[2-corinthians 1 17|2Co.1:17;]] ἤ . . . ἤ . . . ἤ, [[mark 13 35|Mrk.13:35.]] 2. Comparative, than: after comparatives, [[matthew 10 15|Mat.10:15]], [[luke 9 13|Luk.9:13]], [[john 3 19|Jhn.3:19]], [[romans 13 11|Rom.13:11]], al.; after ἕτερον, [[acts 17 21|Act.17:21;]] θέλω (Khüner 3, iv, 303), [[1-corinthians 14 19|1Co.14:19;]] πρὶν ἤ, before, before accusative and inf., [[matthew 1 18|Mat.1:18]] [[mark 14 30|Mrk.14:30]]; after a positive adj. ([[genesis 49 12|Gen.49:12;]] cf. Robertson, Gr., 661), [[matthew 18 8|Mat.18:8]], 9 [[mark 9 43|Mrk.9:43, 45]] 47. 3. with other particles: ἀλλ᾽ ἤ, see: ἀλλά; ἤ γάρ, see: γάρ; ἢ καί, or even, or also, [[matthew 7 10|Mat.7:10]], [[luke 11 11|Luk.11:11, 12]] [[romans 2 15|Rom.2:15 4:9]], al; ἤτοι . . . ἤ, [[romans 6 16|Rom.6:16]] (cf. Wis.11:19). (AS)

ἦ (μήν), see: εἰ, iii, 7. εἰ, conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions. I. Conditional, if; 1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; (a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[matthew 11 14|Mat.11:14]], [[romans 8 25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[mark 4 23|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[john 15 18|Jhn.15:18]], [[1-corinthians 7 9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[luke 16 31|Luk.16:31]], [[romans 8 11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[matthew 12 26|Mat.12:26]], [[romans 4 14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[luke 17 6|Luk.17:6]], [[john 8 39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[matthew 6 23|Mat.6:23]], [[john 5 47|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]]; (b) fut.: [[matthew 26 33|Mat.26:33]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]]; (with) pf.: [[john 11 12|Jhn.11:12]], [[romans 6 5|Rom.6:5]], al.; (d) aor.: [[luke 16 11|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[john 13 32|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[revelation 20 15|Rev.20:15]], al. 2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: [[matthew 12 28|Mat.12:28]], [[john 7 4|Jhn.7:4]], [[romans 5 17|Rom.5:17]], al. 3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1-john 3 13|1Jn.3:13]], al. 5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[numbers 14 3|Num.14:3]]o, [[1-samuel 14 45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[mark 8 12|Mrk.8:12]], [[hebrews 3 11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: [[acts 24 19|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[1-corinthians 14 10|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17. II. Interrogative, if, whether. 1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[matthew 26 63|Mat.26:63]], [[mark 15 36|Mrk.15:36]], [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2]], [[2-corinthians 13 5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[mark 3 2|Mrk.3:2]], [[acts 8 22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1-corinthians 1 16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), [[philippians 3 12|Php.3:12.]] 2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[genesis 17 17|Gen.17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: [[mark 8 23|Mrk.8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[luke 13 23|Luk.13:23, 22:49]], [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2]], al. III. ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, of person(s) pron. I. (a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in [[matthew 3 11|Mat.3:11]], [[mark 1 8|Mrk.1:8]], [[luke 3 16|Luk.3:16]], al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as [[matthew 10 16|Mat.10:16]], [[john 10 17|Jhn.10:17]]; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. [[1-kings 3 8|1Ki.3:8]]), [[acts 9 10|Act.9:10]]; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, [[john 1 23|Jhn.1:23]] (LXX), [[acts 7 32|Act.7:32]] (LXX). (b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, [[john 14 20|Jhn.14:20;]] μου τ. λόγους, [[matthew 7 24|Mat.7:24;]] ὀπίσω μου, [[matthew 3 11|Mat.3:11;]] ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, [[revelation 5 5|Rev.5:5;]] also with the prep. πρός, as [[mark 9 19|Mrk.9:19]], al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as [[luke 10 16|Luk.10:16]], [[john 7 23|Jhn.7:23]], [[mark 14 7|Mrk.14:7]], al. (with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, [[matthew 2 6|Mat.2:6;]] μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, [[mark 9 24|Mrk.9:24.]] (d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, [[judges 11 12|Jdg.11:12]], al.), i.e. what have we in common: [[matthew 8 29|Mat.8:29]], [[mark 1 24|Mrk.1:24, 5:7]], [[luke 8 28|Luk.8:28]], [[john 2 4|Jhn.2:4]]; τί γάρ μοι, [[1-corinthians 5 2|1Co.5:2.]] (e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.). (f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), and I, even I, I also: [[matthew 2 8|Mat.2:8]], [[luke 2 48|Luk.2:48]], [[john 6 56|Jhn.6:56]], [[romans 3 7|Rom.3:7]], [[1-corinthians 7 40|1Co.7:40]], al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, both . . . and, [[john 7 28|Jhn.7:28.]] (AS)
